description.value: 3rd Street Cafe is a cafe located in Sidney, BC, a popular stop on the Saanich Peninsula cycling circuit near the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal. Sidney is a compact, bikeable waterfront town and cafes in this area commonly serve touring cyclists arriving from or departing to the Gulf Islands.
